description: All 417 upstream .test files attempted with the released Python worker and a private build of SDK PR #3. Counts include setup statements, engine-specific expectations, unsupported features, and connector defects; they do not measure independent bugs or production readiness.
provenance_note: Run in an isolated checkout of connector_revision; all recorded source hashes verified against that commit. This predates the returned-column NULL checks and catalog-version guard. The patched SDK is not the default published connector dependency.

failure_observations.note: Ordered, mutually exclusive textual buckets, not root-cause diagnoses. First matching rule wins. No record status or expected result was changed. SET/RESET and utility matches include source SQL that this harness does not emulate. Other failures still need review; unsupported worker function kinds are not inferred solely from directory names.
